rationale: The message reports tested join behaviors and concrete outputs, so it delivers results. It also states observed edge-case facts from probing, fitting evidence_observation as secondary.

evidence.text: Probed join: with l id,name rows 1,2B,2C,3D,empty and r key,val 2X,2Y,3Z,4W,empty: inner outputs header then 2B-X,2B-Y,2C-X,2C-Y,3D-Z.

--left appends unmatched left in left order (1 then empty). --right ordering is right-driven: 2B-X,2C-X,2B-Y,2C-Y,3D-Z, then unmatched 4W and empty. --full: unmatched left first (1), matches, then empty-left, then unmatched rights.
Empty keys ignored unless --nulls, which matches empty. --cross includes all records including empties.
